text: Thank you for telling me. You do not need to make a payment in this chat. Your card has job-loss insurance cover, and our team will check whether a claim can help. I have booked a call with a hardship officer for tomorrow, 12 October, at 11:00. They will explain your options and agree a review date with you. This conversation is recorded. If you are unhappy with how we handle this, you can contact our grievance officer at any time.

handoff.summary: Customer reports job loss and is the sole earner for his family; cannot pay any amount now. Card has job-loss insurance cover: check claim. Explain options and agree a review date.
